excerpt_i18n.en: 2025 marks a pivotal year for large models transitioning from "technological breakthroughs" to "value deepening." Throughout this year, technology and industry have undergone intricate transformations, resonating in sync and accelerating integration. The disruptions of the future are brewing and surging in the dawn of the AI revolution, gradually unveiling a new world to humanity. In this twilight of the era, how to cut through the fog, glimpse opportunities, courageously engage, and embrace this vast, diverse, and complex wave of intelligence is becoming a pressing question for every industry pioneer. Since its inception in 2016, the Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Conference (GAIR) has, over the past nine years, repeatedly stood at the forefront of AI transformation. With a forward-looking vision, it has accurately and profoundly grasped the pulse of AI technology, establishing a core bridge for cutting-edge exchanges among academia, industry, research, and investment. As a bellwether in the field of artificial intelligence, previous GAIR conferences have invited multiple Turing Award and Nobel Prize laureates, 50 academicians, 30 chairs of top international AI conferences, over 100 fellows, and more than 500 renowned entrepreneurs, investors, and innovators to gather and discuss AI. This time is no exception. On December 12-13, in the banquet hall on the third floor of the Sheraton Shenzhen Bo'lin Tianrui Hotel, the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Conference will also bring together hundreds of guests and thousands of experts. It will feature four thematic forums and two closed-door meetings, focusing on topics such as large models, AI computing power, world models, data & one-brain-multiple-forms, and AI hardware, to collectively explore AI.

Esas disrupciones futuras se están gestando y agitando en el amanecer de la revolución de la IA, abriendo lentamente un nuevo mundo para la humanidad. En este alba de la era, cómo despejar la niebla, vislumbrar oportunidades, adentrarse con valentía y abrazar esta vasta, diversa y compleja ola de inteligencia se está convirtiendo en la pregunta crucial para cada pionero de la industria. La "Conferencia Global de Inteligencia Artificial y Robótica" (GAIR), iniciada en 2016, se ha situado en numerosas ocasiones a la vanguardia de la transformación de la IA durante los últimos nueve años, con una visión prospectiva.

items.title: 对话英诺王建明：机器人目前面临的核心问题是数据 | GAIR 2025
items.raw_excerpt: 每晚 10 点，城市渐入静谧，英诺天使基金 ED 王建明的 “专属写作时间” 才刚刚开启；周末的时光，也早已被她固定分配给了采访与写作。 这份坚持，源于一直在坚持做的 “石麻笔记”，最初她只是想随手记录工作中接触的技术信息，未曾想，石麻笔记受到了越来越多业内人士的关注，也在潜移默化中改变着她对机器人行业的认知。 早在具身智能成为资本热词之前，英诺王建明就已经踏入机器人赛道。据科技产业投资平台华芯资本统计，在一级市场，2025 年前七个月，具身智能行业总融资金额超过 300 亿元，在 2024 年上半年，这个数字还只是 75 亿元。资本狂欢的背后，却难掩数据困境。 从 2017 年到现在的 2025 年，她几乎见证了这个行业从默默无闻到名扬世界，也比任何人都清楚，若数据难题不解决，再高的融资额也难以支撑行业走得长远。 英诺王建明坦言：“机器人的数据问题如果不被解决的话，具身行业用现在的范式不一定做得通。” 以下是 AI 科技评论与王建明的对话，AI 科技评论对其进行了不改原意的编辑： 01 只是想要记录而已 AI科技评论：最开始做石麻笔记有遇到困难吗？怎么解决的？ 王建明： 没遇到什么困难，因为非常随性，叫“笔记”其实就是因为这只是工作或学习过程的记录，没有什么期待，所以没有什么困难。 AI科技评论：有给自己规定访谈or写作计划吗? 王建明： 没有，完全是随性随机的，我自己有空并且是感兴趣的话题就会想一下，写一下。 AI科技评论：石麻笔记的文章既有专业深度又能让技术小白看懂，您是怎么把握这个平衡的？ 王建明： 我会从我看论文所产生的问题去发问，因为我自己也不是学术背景，也不会问非常专业的问题，而是从比较容易理解这个工作的点来问的，所以问题比较通俗，受访者的回答也会比较照顾我，会简单的解释一些专业问题，因此写出来的内容对于非技术背景也比较容易消化。 AI科技评论：为什么从投资人

excerpt_i18n.en: At 10 p.m. each night, as the city gradually quiets down, Wang Jianming, ED of Inno Angel Fund, begins her dedicated writing time; weekends are already firmly allocated to interviews and writing. This persistence stems from her ongoing "Shima Notes." Initially, she merely wanted to casually record technical information encountered at work, never expecting that Shima Notes would gain increasing attention from industry insiders and subtly reshape her understanding of the robotics sector. Long before embodied intelligence became a buzzword in capital circles, Inno's Wang Jianming had already entered the robotics track. From 2017 to the present year of 2025, she has almost witnessed the industry's rise from obscurity to global recognition and understands better than anyone that without solving data issues, even the highest financing amounts cannot sustain the industry's long-term growth. Wang Jianming frankly states: "If the data problems of robots are not resolved, the embodied industry may not succeed with the current paradigm." excerpt_i18n.en:
The renowned Chinese video blogger team "Film Hurricane" announced that it has joined Alibaba International, the world's largest B2B cross-border platform, and is fully leveraging AI to expand into overseas markets. It is reported that the team has already received cooperation inquiries from clients in over 30 countries.  

According to the team, they have utilized multiple AI agents on Alibaba International to translate product information with one click, generate multilingual product descriptions and videos tailored for overseas markets, and quickly set up their international store. Their main products include T-shirts, hoodies, sportswear, and accessories, which are consistent with those sold on their domestic e-commerce platform.  

Additionally, when engaging with overseas clients, the Film Hurricane team extensively employs the platform's AI agents to assist in customer service.  

In a program, Tim, the founder of Film Hurricane, stated that through Alibaba International's AI tools, domestic e-commerce experience can be seamlessly replicated overseas. This offers a new pathway for many domestic businesses looking to expand globally.
excerpt_i18n.es: El conocido equipo de videoblogueros chinos "Yingshi Jufeng" ha anunciado su incorporación a Alibaba.com, la mayor plataforma global de comercio electrónico B2B para la expansión internacional, utilizando ampliamente la inteligencia artificial para explorar mercados en el extranjero. Según se informa, el equipo ya ha recibido expresiones de interés de colaboración de clientes en más de 30 países. Se destaca que han empleado múltiples agentes de IA disponibles en Alibaba.com para traducir automáticamente la información de productos, generar descripciones multilingües y videos adaptados a mercados internacionales, permitiendo la rápida apertura de su tienda en línea en el exterior. Los productos principales en su tienda incluyen camisetas, sudaderas con capucha, ropa deportiva y accesorios, coincidiendo con los ofrecidos en su comercio electrónico nacional. Además, en la atención a clientes internacionales, el equipo hace un uso extensivo de las herramientas de IA de la plataforma.
